transcript:
Patient Bot: Hi. I'm not feeling well, and I was hoping to come in today if at all possible.
PGAI Agent: Pivot Point Orthopedics. Part of Pretty Good AI. Am I speaking with James?
Patient Bot: Hi. This is Tom Baker. I've been having some mild chest tightness. And feeling pretty tired today. Uh, no. This is Tom Baker. Was wondering if you have any same day appointments available? I've been feeling some mild chest tightness and a bit of fatigue today. Just a little.
PGAI Agent: Please provide your date of birth.
Patient Bot: Sure, it's August 12th 19 68,
PGAI Agent: Just to confirm, can you please spell your 1st and last name for me?
Patient Bot: Of course, it's t o m for my 1st name and b a k e r for my last name.
PGAI Agent: Would you like to use your phone number to look up your record? If so, please provide the number you have on file with us. If you're not sure, I can confirm your name and date of birth again. Which would you prefer?
Patient Bot: Yes. That would be helpful. My phone number is 5 5 5 1 2 3 4 5 6. 7. Uh, let's just go with the phone number. It's 5 5 5 1 2 4 5 6 7.
PGAI Agent: I have your phone number as 5 1 2 4 5 6 7 and your date of birth as August 12th. 19 68. Is that correct? If so, could you please provide the full area code for your phone number?
Patient Bot: Oh, sorry about that. The full number is 5 5 5 5 1 2 3 4 5 6 7. The area code is 5 5 5. So the whole number is 5 5 5 5 1 2 3 4 5 67.
PGAI Agent: I can't proceed further right now, but I can make sure our clinic support team follows up with you. Please stay on the line while I connect you to our patient support team. Connecting you to a representative. Please wait.
Patient Bot: Thank you. I appreciate
PGAI Agent: Hello. You've reached the Pretty Good AI test line. Goodbye.
Patient Bot: Alright. Thanks for your help. Have a good day. Goodbye.
summary: Tom Baker called Pivot Point Orthopedics requesting a same-day appointment due to mild chest tightness and fatigue. After verifying his identity through his date of birth (August 12, 1968) and phone number (555-512-3456-7), the receptionist was unable to proceed and transferred him to the patient support team.
